evidence.subject: Mathematics
evidence.visualReview: The preserved UPSC final-key scan identifies NDA & NA Examination I 2025, Paper One Mathematics, Series A, 120 questions, zero dropped and 120 scored. Series A was read column-first and checked row-first against the rendered page.

searchLog.result: Official UPSC archive exposes the NDA & NA Examination (I), 2025 Mathematics question paper.
Official 40-page Series A question-paper scan preserved and visually checked.
Preserved four-page mirror of the UPSC final-key scan; page 1 identifies Series A, 120 scored and zero dropped.

signoff.reviewerMethod: Structured HTML transcription was checked for 120-question completeness and sampled against the official Series A scan; every question is tied to its exact English PDF page. The UPSC final-key grid was rendered and checked column-first and row-first.
signoff.classificationMethod: Question-by-question concept pass against the existing NDA Mathematics syllabus, followed by a fresh placement reread by the same AI agent.
